values.subject: First tripartite employment-agreement window and materials for 2026 graduates
values.body_text: The first tripartite employment-agreement window is 2026-05-30 09:00 to 2026-06-05 17:00. The candidate must confirm in the system; the School Career Services Office does not accept proxy confirmation. Materials including the offer letter, identity document, and transcript require personal review before submission.
